editorIntro: The solstice lands on Saturday and the Peninsula will not be quiet. Fire, music, and a six-metre effigy on the bay. Sunday is the reset: hot springs, truffles, and the winter the Peninsula does best.

picks.editorVerdict: The lead event of the winter. Free festival on the Sorrento foreshore: two stages, fire performers, lantern path, food trucks, and the 'Bernie' effigy burn at 6:30pm. Ticketed via Humanitix — book now. The Peninsula's most distinctive winter night.

The Saturday night centrepiece within the festival: fire performers, silent disco, and the effigy burn. Runs 2pm to 9pm. Same free ticket as the main festival. Arrive by 5pm for the lantern path before the burn.

Périgord black season is at peak. Pizza hunts, lunch bundles, or private hunts through the Red Hill and Main Ridge forests. The solstice weekend is still booking — move today if you want Saturday or Sunday.
Live music every Sunday afternoon from the amphitheatre pool stage. Included with afternoon bathing — no separate ticket. The ideal post-solstice Sunday reset. Runs through 28 June.
